pages.text: A mortar and pestle grinds by hand what Create's millstone grinds by power: grain to flour, bone to meal, and coloured minerals to the pigments painters have ground since antiquity: hematite red, goethite yellow, malachite green, azurite blue, pyrolusite black, cinnabar vermilion.
pages.title: Mortar and pestle

pages.text: Hold the mortar in one hand and the material in the other.
